projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z;quarterly probes,not seasonal means or annual envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite declared current-specific signed interval without surface qualification;resolved declared primary lower contour;axis identity remains unvalidated.
projections.branch_scope: Partial17-19N/18.5-16W poleward Mauritania boundary-current context around18N. Klenz2018 proposes naming the poleward surface and undercurrent branches together. Winter upwelling can place the target below opposing equatorward surface flow;relaxation can bring it to the surface. Do not classify the equatorward Canary/coastal jet as the target or infer source water from velocity. Historical seasonal means,100-200m core band and250m reach are not2022 boundaries or annual limits. Fixed northward is not a curved alongshore axis. Existing summer surface route is not a winter/subsurface axis.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.branch_scope: Partial western Baffin Bay74.5-68.5N external coastal/slope context,following the declared southward direction toward Davis Strait. Exclude northward West Greenland Current,Lancaster Sound intrusion,Arctic strait feeders,fjord circulation and southern Davis Strait continuation. Source Arctic-water100-300m band is a component context,not a full-current thickness or bottom;no temperature/salinity class is diagnosed. Fixed southward does not rotate along curved coastal axes. Existing summer near-surface route is not a quarterly subsurface trajectory. Ice/dry/slope support and eddies may censor or confound selection.
